spans.s:
m. (-डः)
The district of Gaur, the central part of Bengal, extending from Bang to Bhuvaneswar in Orissa: the ruins of its capital, called by the same name, are still extensive.
m. plu. (-डाः)
The inhabitants of Gaur.
f. (-डी)
1 Rum or spirit distilled from Gur or molasses.
2 One of the

A style of poetry, the bold and spirited style.
E.
गुड to surround, or गुड raw sugar, and अण् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or relating to Gur or molasses.
n. (-कं)
Rum.
E.
गुड as above, affix of relation ठञ्.
